About SP WorldTech

A technology company focused on useful digital solutions.

SP WorldTech combines software engineering, AI, digital infrastructure and technology education under one professional technology brand.

Our purpose

We help businesses, organizations and individuals turn ideas and operational needs into practical digital products.

Our approach is straightforward: understand the problem, design the right solution, build professionally, deploy carefully, and continue improving where needed.

  • AI and automation

  • Digital infrastructure through World Net Hosting

Founder • SP WorldTech
Executive Leadership

Sunday Prince Augustine

CEO & Founder — SP WorldTech International Digital Solutions

Sunday Prince Augustine is the CEO and Founder of SP WorldTech, a technology company focused on building practical digital solutions across software engineering, artificial intelligence, digital infrastructure, web technologies and technology education.

As the company's founder, he provides strategic leadership and oversees the technology vision, product development, digital innovation and continued growth of SP WorldTech and its technology businesses.

His vision is to build technology solutions that are professional, accessible and useful to businesses, organizations and individuals, while creating a strong digital technology brand capable of serving clients and partners across international markets.

Technology Software engineering, web applications and digital platforms.
Innovation AI, automation and modern digital solutions.
Global Vision Building technology services for businesses and users worldwide.
